components.summary: Own the package constants and the one gap-lineage helper shared by three native loops.
responsibilities: Own __version__, SUITE_ID, MEMBER_IDS and the one gap-lineage helper the three loops share; hold no member logic and no routing.

components.summary: Own the researchguard console and the four member command lines; dispatch each member command directly to its owner.
responsibilities: Dispatch researchguard logic|source|trace|experiment straight to the member main; unknown commands return one typed JSON error.
Own member command lines, including stable source stop rules, trace iteration direction and report/gaps/compare research-state views while retaining complete JSON output.
Pass the already-loaded trace model into logic handoff export so the native CLI carries actual evidence content and polarity.
Expose score-actions from the same complete native plan scoring path as plan --all-scores, without a candidate limit.
Compare versions of one source model using actual gap semantic fields and nested qualification decision; self-comparison reports no change and retired gap.status stays rejected.
Create complete synthetic source and trace starter models whose sample data and evidence boundaries stay explicit.
Expose canonical --source-id intake/import and --source-model provenance checking; retire the unconsumed SourceGuard LogicGuard export.
Dispatch status to the read-only research tree view while retaining member help and version formats. Expose --into on source-to-trace and trace-to-logic handoffs, requiring a distinct output file.
side_effects: member commands perform their existing explicit file writes

components.summary: Own argument support, source library, structured artifacts, model deepening, synthesis and project library inspection.
responsibilities: Own argument support, source library, structured artifacts, model deepening, synthesis and project library inspection.

Run depth analysis on the model alone; synthesis computes depth in process. Use an internal implicit unit/card only when inventory and role declarations are absent, preserving explicit empty declarations and model identity. Shared Evidence is informational; other shared role nodes retain consumer checks.

Run the predict-observe-revise loop on plain model files; the loop never writes model files, so rollback is restoring the previous file; every claim, node and coverage id a prediction names must exist in the model when it is frozen.
Derive minimal support and attack sets split by the edge that enters the claim; a blocked claim reports its native blockers as the attack set and preserves the wording license.
Bind Evidence to sources and exact UTF-8 quotes or matching content hashes, report invalid provenance with node ids, and resolve library source_id/locator on validate --library-root.
Collect argument evaluation and native depth gaps from baseline and candidate; delegate gap transitions to the suite helper, with prior ids used only for argument stagnation.

Import a data-only trace bundle as signed per-hypothesis claims and content-bound evidence provenance, with legacy trace-only claim compatibility and no invented warrants. Support add-only handoff sync by node and edge identities with conflict reporting and preserved hand-built work.

Resolve provenance from plain SourceGuard source/anchor data, accepting same-source library nodes when supplied; preserve explicit canonical source ids on intake and reject conflicting content. Route evidence search gaps to SourceGuard planning.
side_effects: native file writes only through explicit commands

components.summary: Own evidence discovery, expected-utility search plans, stop decisions and source/anchor qualification.
responsibilities: Own evidence discovery, expected-utility search plans, stop decisions, source/anchor qualification and readable source/anchor/closure reporting.
Load, plan, update and iterate on a model file alone; models carry no contract; the action and every protected or coverage gap a prediction names must exist in the model when it is frozen.

Decide whether to keep searching from the model itself: all executable declared and generated actions, selecting an affordable target by native utility, the open blocking gaps and the caller-declared budget.
Combine source semantic-state, depth and coverage gaps from each actual model and delegate transition sets to the shared suite helper; resolved obligations alone count as progress.
Read all recorded observations for native depth and preview a new observation only on a clone; current-call provider status remains explicit.
Generate gap queries from the gap description and at most two domain hints, bounded to 120 characters; preserve executable declared actions and suppress their generated duplicates.
Default only absent gap semantic_state to discovered, keep retired status invalid, and warn on synthetic starter ids during validation.

Be the sole owner of source ids, roles, lineage and anchors; export a TraceGuard seed, with no unconsumed LogicGuard candidate export. Support add-only trace seed sync by source/anchor ids, listing content conflicts and retaining all downstream fields; claim-usable anchors are trace-usable.
side_effects: native file writes only through explicit commands

components.summary: Own temporal and causal trace inference, storyline stress and case library updates.
responsibilities: Own temporal and causal trace inference, storyline stress, case library updates and readable timeline/hypothesis/depth reporting.
Keep command output to analysis results; full JSON is written only with --output.
Solve storyline support from evidence first; bound causal support below it. Depth checks that neither causal declarations nor oppose links raise support; evaluate does not run depth.
Freeze with an existing target and coverage; permit future expected evidence/event ids. Append typed observation rows in memory and compare canonical target support direction.

Preserve newly observed rows in candidates; acceptance is independent of native depth closure. Keep prediction mismatches separate from native gaps, use the suite lineage helper and count only resolved native gaps as progress.
Export hypothesis ids, native rank/support and signed evidence with original text/source/locator alongside the preserved v1 trace claims.
side_effects: native file writes only through explicit commands

components.summary: Own finite minimum experiment sets, observation-driven iteration, optional holdout checks and bounded terminal decisions.
responsibilities: Distinguish hypotheses within the declared finite count limit; minimize optional declared costs before count and IDs, retain cost mode in remaining recommendations, and exclude the selected set from alternatives. Report limit failures separately from truly indistinguishable pairs.
License native closure only for a unique consistent hypothesis with no holdout counterexample and no gaps, while preserving the finite iteration limit first; holdout observations are optional.

Continue a bounded multi-survivor iteration only with a concrete distinguishing next candidate; preserve valid construction eliminations across matrix misses and never close zero survivors. Do not infer historical progress from unchanged gaps; malformed specs return one JSON error.
Load native experiment specifications and observations for both the CLI and research folder view.
side_effects: native file writes only through explicit commands

components.summary: Own skill installation by copy, privacy checks and the route-file prompt budgets.
responsibilities: Own ordinary package/skill installation, privacy checks, prompt budgets and source validation.
side_effects: copy the researchguard skill folder into the given skills directory and remove retired member skill folders

components.summary: Read one research folder, check shared ids and project native route results.
responsibilities: Load research.yaml and native route models without rewriting them.
Check shared hypothesis ids, root claims and canonical source/anchor references in memory.
Project native logic, trace depth, source planning and experiment observation/recommendation results into a Markdown or JSON status page.
Ship the bounded Ever Given research tree with common ids and replay cross-reference checks on native in-memory models.
